what: The Mesen measurements of streambound-curve.json were taken on the generator in curve.provenance.generator. This record certifies they stand for the generator in finalGenerator: every record that ran Mesen was rebuilt on that tree, with no Mesen, by the sweep's own scene builder, and its project hash and ROM hash equal the recorded ones. A later generator-only change is certified by re-running test/lua/sw_rebuild_check.mjs; a change whose ROMs differ needs a re-sweep. (Re-made 2026-10-05, phase 3b slice S0 (battle backdrop), on the S0 engine: the record was swept on the generator it is certified for, so recordedGenerator equals finalGenerator; stage P, the probe, is part of it.)
